issues.body: `render_probe_alert()` still says both "The weekly validity probe" and "updates itself on the weekly probe", although this PR changes the schedule and documentation to daily. This is the same unresolved round-1 finding and gives responders an incorrect expectation of alert cadence and detection latency.
issues.fix_hint: Change both operator-facing occurrences of "weekly" in `render_probe_alert()` to "daily", and add a rendering assertion tied to the daily cadence so this message cannot drift again.
issues.title: Probe-health alert still describes the daily probe as weekly

verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

The ledger-branch counter implementation remains sound: it distinguishes a missing document from an unavailable branch, validates the stored document and blob SHA, pins reads and writes to the ledger ref, and uses the read SHA for compare-and-swap updates. The workflow contract tests exact permissions and daily scheduling. However, round 1's minor operator-facing cadence defect is unchanged: the alert still tells responders that the now-daily probe is weekly. Because the same minor finding remains at the same severity, progress is stagnant. No blocker or major issue found.
